## Design

### 2026-10-15 – Pumpkin looking wheel and base draft for the chassis made on onshape.

**6h**

Pumpkin looking wheel and base draft for the chassis made on onshape.

Since this was the first time i've actually tried onshape, it took me some time to get used to the controls and the features. First i watched some youtube vids to get a foundational understanding of how to use the software. After which i spent some time making basic things like a mug, a simple cylinder.
One thing that was worth saying was when i found out the remove feature so i could make the d shaft that would fit my wheel. THe pic is down here.

![Screenshot 2026-10-15 221409](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/17fq1CCI0defrIHUptaVBPTb2uK8rssi/272cc48631ab4db0a9d5d9d84a405878c2456a3f69467fff71921811cf2be240.png)

Though this is just the start as you can see from the pic, i will be working on it more to make it better structurally so it can actually handle the pressure of the entire bot.
THis is the chassis btw. Im thinking of making it a 3 part cuboid stacked on top of each other so it can fit all the components of the bot.

![Screenshot 2026-10-15 221325](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/17fq1CCI0defrIHUptaVBPTb2uK8rssi/1f47ed03360ffbef2f6e61346bb91f1ed7befec8aa96948cf4bff03f99851a6e.png)

### 2026-10-17 – This time i added another compartment for the chassis that will hold all of my electronics like the motor drivers, the IMU sensors, the esp 32 etc. THis extension allows me to make the center of mass

**2h**

This time i added another compartment for the chassis that will hold all of my electronics like the motor drivers, the IMU sensors, the esp 32 etc. THis extension allows me to make the center of mass of the entire thing go verticallly upwards which is technically better for the sensor and the tuning of the bot it self. There is more to add as i still need to figure out how exactly the parts are going to be fitted on to the thing. Fture changes might include small adjustments to make the wiring and the circuitry easier to handle.
